ValidationRule.description: Validation to check the contract valid to and contract valid from difference is greater than 30 days to support salesforce OOB contract creation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRByPassToggle__c )), PMC_CPQ_ContractEnd__c - PMC_CPQ_ContractStart__c <30 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure the duration in between Contract Valid From and Contract Valid To date is more than 30 days
